summary: Every criterion with code behind it has merged work to point at: D66 supersedes D28 and amends D1/D27/D31/D33/D39/D41 (V11); jenkins-prd/destroy-stage and its two gate-pinned Roles (V12); presync.destroy with forget/plan/apply/state-rm and unittest coverage of dry run, apply, re-runs, missing config/<stage>/, a non-planning root and a namespaced Secret beside a PV and an RBD image (V03/V04/V07/V15/V20), with cli.py, test_cli.py and the ENTRYPOINT untouched (V14); Jenkinsfile.destroy-stage's guard, Job, config removal and options, plus the job created through createItem (V02/V05/V07/V17/V18); the runbook section (V19). What remains is the test phase's (V08, V09, V13, V16, V17's registration build, per Rulings D3/D4) and the operator's APPLY=true (V10, close-out A1); the D28 citations in argo-cd design.md/phases.md and kubecoder-cutover.md are routed to the doc phase by P1's and P6's done-records. The one piece of mechanical residue, close-out P2's stale docstring in ArgoCDDeploy tests/render-chart.py, is fixed in b8d1a0c (gate green) and struck; every other close-out entry is out of the plan's scope or a judgement for the operator, and none clears the bar for a phase.
